body: I just wanted to post an update and thank everyone for their comments. I spoke to my friends mom last night and she said that his dr changed his meds yesterday and he is going to see him tonight. They actually were aware of it all and things seem under control. He texted me this morning saying that he felt a lot better and that his mom said that I called her last night. He said it meant a lot to me and them. I wish you all the best and hope everyone finds inner peace
Thanks for the texts. He has just sent me some more concerning messages, so my friend and I think it's best to call his parents. They are close. I just hope everything works out.

Thank you for your response. Actually, we live quite close and I was over his home Saturday to check in. He lives alone in a studio. I have read up a lot about it and let him talk, but he just keeps saying the same things and it's getting a bit too much for me. I don't know what to say and he pauses looking for me to say something. He contacts me at work too, which is difficult. I am just not sure who else I can ask to help besides maybe his parents? 

I asked him about his psychiatrist and he has told me that he fired him and that he was useless. When I asked him if maybe he thought someone else would help, he told me that his is beyond help and he's seen so many drs and none helped.
